fields.name: remaining_target_positions
fields.description: An ordered list of the original cube positions for requested container pickups not yet completed, in the order specified by the goal. Initialize from the visible cubes at the first decision step, including only requested colors. Retain the original coordinates despite pixel wobble or subsequent covering. Remove the first entry at the decision step showing that its container has actually been grasped and lifted, not at the step selecting the pickup. Putting a container back does not restore its entry. Thus episode 71 has [[92, 93], [128, 118]] at steps 1 and 2 and [[128, 118]] at steps 3 and 4. The other episodes retain their single initial target throughout their two recorded steps. e.g. [[92, 93], [128, 118]]
